code: const BASE='/api';function authHeaders(){const token=localStorage.getItem('token');return{'Content-Type':'application/json',...(token?{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}:{})};}async function request(method,path,body){const res=await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`,{method,headers:authHeaders(),...(body!==undefined?{body:JSON.stringify(body)}:{})});const data=await res.json();if(!res.ok)throw new Error(data.error||'Request failed');return data;}export const api={get:path=>request('GET',path),post:(path,body)=>request('POST',path,body),patch:(path,body)=>request('PATCH',path,body),delete:path=>request('DELETE',path)};
